posts.text:
On this Eid al-Adha, I’m thinking of Minnesota’s Muslim community and all those gathered in prayer today, especially following today’s tragic shooting at an Eid prayer service at Canterbury Park.

My thoughts are with the victim's family and the entire community.

Was in Rochester today for the groundbreaking on Rochester International Airport's General Aviation ramp. I worked to secure federal funding to break ground on this project that will modernize aging infrastructure and improve airport safety. ✈️

A Bar of Their Own in Minneapolis has been named the country's best local sports bar. A well-deserved honor for this incredible sports bar that celebrates women's sports!

startribune.com/a-bar-of-the…

Keeping costs down for farmers and families starts with keeping production local. 

The Central Farm Service and Minnesota Farmers Union are working together to do just that – and this is the kind of innovation our state needs. Good to be there with Gary Wertish and KC Graner.

Video

Talarico is going to win this.


James Talarico (@jamestalarico)

Ken Paxton is the most corrupt politician in America. 

He embodies the broken system we’re running against.

It’s time to come together: The People vs. Ken Paxton

I was honored to attend the ceremony at Fort Snelling yesterday.

All those buried there are heroes — ordinary people who did extraordinary things. Americans who fought for a future where liberty prevails.

Video

Republican North Carolina Senator Thom Tillis is right that Congress decides how taxpayer dollars are spent — not the president.

And your money shouldn’t go to people convicted of assaulting law enforcement and the Capitol on January 6th.

Video

As Americans, we will have political differences. But two values always unite us: our respect for our country, and our respect for the men and women who serve it.

Video
Voting is a right, not a privilege. The SAVE Act won’t save anything. It will strip Americans of their right to vote. We have to fight back to protect our democracy.

At Fort Snelling National Cemetery today I visited my dad’s gravesite. He was proud to be a veteran, and now rests among the “heroes among us” he so often wrote about — the brave men and women who served our country with courage and humility.

I spoke at the Memorial Day Ceremony at Fort Snelling National Cemetery to honor heroes like Nicole Amor of White Bear Lake, who died serving in Kuwait this year, and Captain Bianchi of New Ulm, who gave his life in World War II.

Their courage helped secure the freedoms we enjoy today.

On Memorial Day, we honor the brave men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country and remember the families who carry their legacy forward. That includes Joey Amor and the Amor kids & family. Nicole Amor of White Bear Lake died this year in Kuwait, bravely serving our nation. 

Our soldiers’ sacrifice can never be forgotten.

May is Pool Safety Month, a time to raise awareness about drowning prevention and keeping kids safe.  I’ve worked to strengthen pool safety protections so families can enjoy Minnesota summers safely.🌊⛱️
Stopped by the Copper Pony in Sauk Rapids for some coffee and cookies on this beautiful Sunday. Great to meet their staff!

In Little Falls today for the Minnesota State Memorial Day Cemetery to honor the fallen men and women who gave everything for our country. Their sacrifice can never be forgotten, and we carry a duty to those who laid down their lives so we could live ours.

Thank you to the Northern Midwest Regional Council of Carpenters for their endorsement. I grew up in a union family and I believe in the strength of Minnesota’s workforce — and as Governor, I will make sure that hard work is respected and rewarded.

Honored to earn the endorsement of Education Minnesota. My mom taught 2nd grade until she was 70, and education made my family’s story possible.

I will work to strengthen our schools and focus on success for our students, parents, educators and state.

Minnesota is home to many incredible restaurants. Great to see National Geographic name Minneapolis one of the top 15 global destinations for food.

startribune.com/minneapolis-…

We might still be 95 days from my favorite time of year, but this weekend you can get a taste of the Minnesota State Fair.

Video

Gas prices are up more than 40% from a year ago.

Americans are paying the price for the president’s war with Iran at the pump, at the grocery store, and in their summer travel plans.


Forbes (@Forbes)
